related.title: Troll 海上油氣平臺
related.why: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.whyEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.transferEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界；Troll 海上油氣平臺改以重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries; Troll offshore oil/gas platforms centers on gravity bases, shore power and compression support, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照天然氣資源與庫存與Troll油氣與壓力，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Troll 海上油氣平臺，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以可用率與事件證據為起點，設計一項能區分「海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界」與「重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare gas resources/inventory with troll oil/gas pressure and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Troll offshore oil/gas platforms, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from availability/event evidence and propose an observation distinguishing offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries from gravity bases, shore power and compression support, including uncertainty.

related.title: Sleipner 油氣與碳封存

practiceEn: Compare gas resources/inventory with hydrocarbon/co2 balance and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from availability/event evidence and propose an observation distinguishing offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries from separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries, including uncertainty.

history.title: Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程
history.text: Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程的公開資料展示海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering illustrate offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型

history.textEn: The course turns offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
